Senior Python Data Engineer M/V/X
Référence 5909037
|
Créé le 27 juillet 2026
Retour à la liste
Temps de travail :
Temps plein
Type de contrat :
Durée déterminée
Famille de métiers :
Informatique / Services informatiques
Nombre d'années d'expérience :
Minimum 4 ans d'expérience
Description de la fonction
We are looking for a
Senior Python Data Engineer
to join an innovative AI-driven migration program aimed at modernizing legacy data processing applications through intelligent automation.
In this role, you will combine strong software engineering expertise with modern AI-assisted development practices to help industrialize an AI-powered migration factory. You will actively contribute to the development of high-quality Python data pipelines while improving the orchestration of AI agents responsible for automating large parts of the migration lifecycle.
This position is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex data engineering challenges while shaping the future of AI-assisted software development
Key Responsibilities
Python Data Engineering
Design, develop, and optimize Python-based data transformation solutions.
Review, validate, and improve AI-generated Python code to ensure production readiness.
Ensure high standards of code quality, performance, maintainability, and operational reliability.
Support complex migration scenarios requiring manual refinement beyond automated code generation.
Develop and optimize modern data processing pipelines.
Contribute to data quality, schema evolution, metadata management, and Parquet optimization.
Support distributed data processing using PySpark when appropriate.
AI-Assisted Development & Agent Engineering
Act as a key contributor to an AI-assisted software migration platform.
Improve the orchestration framework responsible for coordinating multiple specialized AI agents.
Enhance collaboration between AI agents responsible for:
Legacy SAS code analysis
Functional analysis generation
Technical design generation
Python code generation
Automated validation and testing
Improve workflow orchestration, traceability, scalability, and reliability.
Strengthen human-in-the-loop validation processes and feedback mechanisms.
Identify opportunities to increase automation while maintaining software quality and governance.
Contribute to the continuous evolution of AI-assisted development practices and engineering standards.
Profil
Required Skills & Experience
Python & Data Engineering
Minimum
5 years of professional experience
developing Python applications.
Strong expertise in:
Python
Pandas
Polars
PyArrow
Parquet
Unit and integration testing frameworks
Proven experience building and maintaining:
Data engineering solutions
ETL / ELT pipelines
Data transformation workflows
Data quality controls
Schema management
Experience with
PySpark
is considered a strong advantage.
AI-Assisted Development
Experience working with modern AI-assisted software engineering tools and workflows, including:
GitHub Copilot or equivalent AI coding assistants
AI-assisted software development
Multi-agent systems
Agentic workflows
Agent orchestration frameworks
Human-in-the-loop validation processes
Workflow automation and optimization
